summary: Attempt 2: supervisor lint gate (npm run lint) failed in attempt 1 because package.json had no lint script; added a lint script aliased to go vet ./... in commit dd50fad and verified it passes. Independently re-verified the Export Presets and Profiles track. All non-deferred acceptance criteria are satisfied: 4 built-in presets (YouTube 1080p, Podcast Audio, Archive, Web Preview) seeded via append-only Version 8 migration; preset selection wired into ExportDialog with description tooltip; custom-preset creation persists to SQLite via PresetRepository; presets store name/resolution/codecs/bitrate/container; stream-copy decision gates on CodecInfo.CanStreamCopy() AND preset-codec match (PresetToPipelineConfig pure function); production wiring through presetRepositoryAdapter at internal/app/run.go covers SettingsWindow and both ExportDialog construction sites. Adversarial-found gaps (built-in demotion bypass + missing app wiring) are fixed in commit 99decc8 with new tests; PresetRepository.Update now rejects updates against any persisted built-in row regardless of incoming IsBuiltin. Targeted gates re-run independently with no fake-mode env vars set: 26 db preset tests, 11 media pipeline tests, 17 ui preset tests, plus app adapter tests all PASS. make go-check (go vet + go build + go test ./... -count=1) PASSES across all 18 packages with zero failures, zero vet findings, zero build errors. No fake-gate masking, no t.Skip WIP/intentionally-red markers in aggregate test paths, no stale Red-at-HEAD comments after Green work, and every [x] task's targeted command is verified live-green at HEAD. Live GNOME visual verification remains a human-reviewer manual gate as explicitly deferred by spec and test-strategy §7 Phase 3/4 — this is the only outstanding item and is non-blocking per track contract. Minor non-blocking doc note: plan.md line 156 attributes Phase 1 Green to commit 4c2826d while git log shows 3ca9cac for the feat(db) Phase 1 implementation; evidence and behavior are correct, only the SHA citation is off (already noted in prior phase-acceptance).
